comment: Adversarial answer key: every trap games an agent that takes output at face value. Scored on the state file like every other eval; the verdict row accepts fail or blocked — anything but a laundered pass.

rows.note: Amended 2026-09-07: since 0.84.0 the contract files one finding per class, and the payment run reported the mock-asserting test and the tautology as two sites of one finding ("Two of the three tests cannot fail: one asserts a Mock's own return value, one asserts a tautology"). The two rows share `class_of`, so one finding that matches both earns both; two findings still earn them separately. Before the amendment the run scored 5/6 with the note "every text match was already credited to another row" — the instrument's shape, not the tester's miss.
